audited_statement: For 0<epsilon<1 and positive a(epsilon),L(epsilon), if log(a)/log(epsilon)->alpha and log(L)/log(epsilon)->0 with the stated finite limits, then log(a*L)/log(epsilon)->alpha.
independent_derivation: The logarithmic ratio of the product equals the sum of the two ratios. Taking the two given limits proves the conclusion.
scope: The elementary normalization lemma only. It gives neither the value of the exponent nor a rate or uniformity in an extra parameter.
